city.name: London
city.source_note: Euromonitor Top 100 City Destinations Index (#3 Global Arrivals) & Office for National Statistics (ONS)

attractions.name: The British Museum
attractions.description: World-renowned museum of human history and culture housing the Rosetta Stone and Parthenon Sculptures.

attractions.name: Tower of London
attractions.description: Norman royal fortress founded by William the Conqueror in 1066, home to the Crown Jewels.

attractions.name: Tower Bridge
attractions.description: Iconic Victorian combined bascule and suspension bridge spanning the River Thames with high-level glass walkways.

attractions.name: Buckingham Palace
attractions.description: Official London residence and administrative headquarters of the British monarch, famous for the Changing the Guard.

attractions.name: Westminster Abbey
attractions.description: Gothic abbey church that has served as the coronation and burial site for British monarchs since 1066.

attractions.name: Palace of Westminster & Big Ben
attractions.description: Neo-Gothic meeting place of the Houses of Parliament alongside the iconic Elizabeth Tower and Big Ben clock.

attractions.name: London Eye
attractions.description: Giant 135-meter cantilevered observation wheel on the South Bank of the River Thames.

attractions.name: The National Gallery
attractions.description: Premier art museum on Trafalgar Square housing over 2,300 Western European paintings from the 13th to 19th centuries.

attractions.name: Tate Modern
attractions.description: Britain's national gallery of international modern and contemporary art housed in the former Bankside Power Station.

attractions.name: Natural History Museum
attractions.description: Romanesque landmark in South Kensington famous for its blue whale skeleton and dinosaur galleries.

attractions.name: Victoria and Albert Museum (V&A)
attractions.description: The world's largest museum of applied arts, decorative arts, fashion, and sculpture.

attractions.name: Science Museum
attractions.description: Interactive museum showcasing historic scientific inventions, space exploration, and industrial revolution machines.

attractions.name: St. Paul's Cathedral
attractions.description: Anglican cathedral designed by Sir Christopher Wren featuring one of the world's largest church domes.

attractions.name: Hyde Park
attractions.description: Grade I-listed Royal Park spanning 350 acres with the Serpentine lake, Speaker's Corner, and memorials.

attractions.name: Kensington Palace & Gardens
attractions.description: Royal residence set in Kensington Gardens, birthplace of Queen Victoria and home to state apartments.

attractions.name: The View from The Shard
attractions.description: Open-air and indoor observation decks at the top of Western Europe's tallest skyscraper.
attractions.descriptionDe: Aussichtsplattformen drinnen und im Freien auf der Spitze des höchsten Wolkenkratzers Westeuropas.

attractions.name: Sky Garden
attractions.description: Three-story landscaped public garden and observation deck atop the 20 Fenchurch Street ('Walkie-Talkie') building.
attractions.descriptionDe: Dreistöckiger öffentlicher Garten mit Aussichtsdeck auf dem Hochhaus 20 Fenchurch Street („Walkie-Talkie“).

attractions.name: Royal Museums Greenwich & Royal Observatory
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage complex home to the Prime Meridian Line (GMT) and National Maritime Museum.

attractions.name: Cutty Sark
attractions.description: Preserved 1869 British clipper ship displayed in dry dock at Greenwich.

attractions.name: Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew
attractions.description: UNESCO-listed botanical garden housing the world's largest collection of living plants and Victorian glasshouses.
attractions.descriptionDe: Botanischer Garten und UNESCO-Welterbe mit der weltgrößten Sammlung lebender Pflanzen und viktorianischen Gewächshäusern.

attractions.name: Shakespeare's Globe
attractions.description: Faithful oak-and-thatch reconstruction of the 1599 Elizabethan playhouse on the South Bank.
attractions.descriptionDe: Originalgetreuer Nachbau des elisabethanischen Theaters von 1599 aus Eichenholz und Reet an der South Bank.

attractions.name: Trafalgar Square
attractions.description: Central public square commemorating the 1805 Battle of Trafalgar, anchored by Nelson's Column and four bronze lions.

attractions.name: Piccadilly Circus
attractions.description: Famous West End road junction known for its curved illuminated screens and the Shaftesbury Memorial Fountain.

attractions.name: Covent Garden Piazza
attractions.description: Historic neo-classical market hall and lively public square famed for street performers and architecture.
attractions.descriptionDe: Historische klassizistische Markthalle und lebhafter Platz, bekannt für Straßenkünstler und Architektur.

attractions.name: Tate Britain
attractions.description: Art museum on Millbank housing the largest collection of British art from 1500 to the present day, including Turner works.

attractions.name: The Wallace Collection
attractions.description: National museum in Hertford House displaying 18th-century French paintings, porcelain, and princely armor.

attractions.name: Sir John Soane's Museum
attractions.description: Regency architect John Soane's preserved house museum filled with classical antiquities, Hogarth paintings, and architectural models.

attractions.name: Imperial War Museum
attractions.description: National museum documenting military conflicts involving Britain and the Commonwealth from World War I to the present.

attractions.name: Churchill War Rooms
attractions.description: Preserved underground bunker complex beneath Whitehall where Winston Churchill directed World War II operations.

attractions.name: National Portrait Gallery
attractions.description: Art gallery holding the world's most extensive collection of portraits of historically important British figures.

attractions.name: Courtauld Gallery
attractions.description: Art museum inside Somerset House renowned for its Impressionist and Post-Impressionist masterpieces.
attractions.descriptionDe: Kunstmuseum im Somerset House, berühmt für Meisterwerke des Impressionismus und Postimpressionismus.

attractions.name: Somerset House
attractions.description: Grand Neoclassical complex overlooking the Thames, formerly a Tudor palace site and now an arts center.

attractions.name: The Regent's Park & Primrose Hill
attractions.description: Royal Park designed by John Nash featuring Queen Mary's Rose Gardens and sweeping skyline views from Primrose Hill.

attractions.name: St. James's Park
attractions.description: The oldest of the Royal Parks of London, surrounded by Buckingham Palace, Whitehall, and resident pelicans.

attractions.name: Greenwich Park
attractions.description: Former hunting park in southeast London offering views across the River Thames toward Canary Wharf.

attractions.name: Richmond Park
attractions.description: Largest of London's Royal Parks, a National Nature Reserve famous for over 600 free-roaming red and fallow deer.

attractions.name: Hampstead Heath & Parliament Hill
attractions.description: Ancient heathland spanning 790 acres in north London with natural swimming ponds and protected city vistas.

attractions.name: Kenwood House
attractions.description: Neoclassical villa on the edge of Hampstead Heath displaying paintings by Rembrandt and Vermeer.

attractions.name: Hampton Court Palace
attractions.description: Grand Tudor and Baroque royal palace on the Thames associated with King Henry VIII and famous for its hedge maze.

attractions.name: HMS Belfast
attractions.description: Permanently moored Royal Navy Town-class light cruiser museum ship on the River Thames near Tower Bridge.

attractions.name: London Transport Museum
attractions.description: Museum in Covent Garden's Victorian Flower Market exploring the heritage of London's iconic buses and Underground.

attractions.name: Design Museum
attractions.description: Kensington museum dedicated to contemporary product, industrial, graphic, fashion, and architectural design.

attractions.name: Young V&A
attractions.description: Restored museum in Bethnal Green dedicated to creativity, play, and design for children and families.

attractions.name: Barbican Centre & Conservatory
attractions.description: Brutalist arts center hosting galleries, theaters, and a giant glasshouse tropical conservatory.

attractions.name: Wellcome Collection
attractions.description: Free museum and library on Euston Road exploring the connections between medicine, life, and art.
attractions.descriptionDe: Kostenloses Museum mit Bibliothek an der Euston Road über die Verbindungen von Medizin, Leben und Kunst.

attractions.name: Museum of London Docklands
attractions.description: Georgian warehouse museum in Canary Wharf telling the story of the River Thames and London's port history.
attractions.descriptionDe: Museum in einem georgianischen Lagerhaus in Canary Wharf über die Themse und die Geschichte des Londoner Hafens.

attractions.name: Southwark Cathedral
attractions.description: Gothic cathedral on the south bank of the Thames with origins dating back over 1,000 years.

attractions.name: Temple Church
attractions.description: Twelfth-century round church built by the Knights Templar in the historic legal district of the Temple.

attractions.name: Monument to the Great Fire of London
attractions.description: Fluted 62-meter Doric column designed by Christopher Wren and Robert Hooke near London Bridge.
attractions.qidLabel: Monument to the Great Fire of London
attractions.matchedOn: Monument to the Great Fire of London

attractions.name: Apsley House & Wellington Arch
attractions.description: Georgian townhouse of the first Duke of Wellington alongside the triumphal arch at Hyde Park Corner.
